checks: desktop, tablet and mobile: both definitions, overflow, axe, screenshots
mobile navigation: toggle, Escape, focus return, route change
table search, numeric sort and empty feedback
popover: keyboard open, checkbox changes density, Escape restores focus
tooltip: focus opens help, Escape dismisses
drawer and nested dialog: focus trap, Escape only closes top layer, focus return
tabs: arrow navigation, Home/End, selected panel and tab order
dialog: open, focus containment, backdrop dismissal, mobile bounds
form: required errors, linked labels, native selection, typed zero/false, repeat creates
conversation: send through action/capability, reply, draft clear, focus retained
